biography_english:
A disciple of the Sea God Vasque who survived a purge of the enemies of Hierophant Balbatos. Her village was attacked by Jeunan's wyrmknights, and now lies in ruin. A handful of survivors took shelter at Lhazan Fortress.
  The Bakram attacked the fortress, and all the villagers save Ocionne were slaughtered. She took up arms with the Resistance despite her grief, but later fell in battle.
biography_spanish:
Discipula del Dios del Mar Vasque sobrevivio a la purga del Hierofante Balbatos. Su aldea fue atacada por caballero Dragon de Jeunan y yace en ruinas. Pocos supervivientes se refugiaron en la Fortaleza de Lhazan.        
  Los bakram atacaron la fortaleza y todos los aldeanos salvo Ocionne fueron masacrados. Tomo las armas con la Resistencia a pesar de su dolor, pero cayo en combate.

  He took Catiua hostage and fled to Almorica Castle, but met a tragic end through Vyce's betrayal.

biography_english: A knight with an air of mystery about him. He fought to protect his sister Oelias after they were attacked by undead at Port Asyton, but was slain.

biography_english: A Galgastani from Brigantys. He is the son of the Necromancer Nybeth, and brother to Oelias. When war broke out he was slain for opposing Hierophant Balbatos, but his father later resurrected him through necromancy. However, his new body consists of a patchwork of corpses, and he has changed irrevocably.
biography_spanish: Un Galgastani de Brigantys. Es hijo del nigromante Nybeth y hermano de Oelias. Al estallar la guerra fue asesinado por oponerse al jerarca Balbatos, pero su padre lo resucito mas tarde mediante nigromancia. Sin embargo, su nuevo cuerpo es un remiendo de cadaveres y ha cambiado de forma irrevocable.

biography_english: A knight who once fought for the Kingdom of Galgastan. He was killed in battle with the Resistance, but later resurrected by the Necromancer Nybeth. He led a band of undead abominations in an assault on Almorica Castle, but was defeated by {hero}.
biography_spanish: Un caballero que lucho por el Reino de Galgastan. Murio en combate con la Resistencia, pero fue resucitado por el nigromante Nybeth. Lidero un grupo de abominaciones no muertas en un asalto al Castillo de Almorica, pero fue derrotado por {hero}.

biography_english:
A Galgastani from Brigantys. He is the son of the Necromancer Nybeth. When war broke out he was slain for opposing Hierophant Balbatos, but his father later resurrected him through necromancy. However, his new body consists of a patchwork of corpses, and he has changed irrevocably.
  It seems he knows something of Sibyl Oelias's past, but he does not speak of it.

  Parece saber algo del pasado de la sibila Oelias, pero no habla de ello.

biography_english: A sibyl who wandered the war-torn lands. She was attacked by undead at Port Asyton. She fought back with her brother Dievold, but died in the skirmish.
biography_spanish: Una sibila que vagaba por tierras en guerra. Fue atacada por no muertos en Puerto Asyton. Lucho junto a su hermano Dievold, pero murio en el combate.

biography_english:
A Galgastani from Brigantys. She is the daughter of the Necromancer Nybeth. She resented her father's debasement of human life, and sought solace in the Order. When her brother Dievold fell victim to Nybeth's necromancy, she resolved to confront him. Together with Dievold she set off to locate their father.
  She is fiercely protective of her brother, who is now cut off from the world of the living.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani de Brigantys. Es hija del nigromante Nybeth. Rechazaba como su padre degradaba la vida humana y busco consuelo en la Orden. Cuando su hermano Dievold fue victima de la nigromancia de Nybeth, decidio enfrentarlo. Junto a Dievold partio para buscar a su padre.                                   
  Es ferozmente protectora de su hermano, que ahora esta aislado del mundo de los vivos.
